source.title: Important Changes to the Recognition of Regions
source.content:
Dear WCA Community,

We are able to share some important updates regarding our organization's alignment with the international standards set by the sporting community. After careful consideration of recommendations made by a specialized working group within the WCA Sports Organization Team (WSOT), we have made the following changes to our regions, effective immediately:

Hong Kong, China (Formerly Hong Kong) 
Macau, China (Formerly Macau) 
Chinese Taipei (Formerly Taiwan)

Furthermore, Chinese Taipei will now operate under the WCA Chinese Taipei flag, which will be rolled out through WCA services progressively over the coming month.

We want to emphasize that this decision was not made lightly. This is purely an effort to align with the IOC’s standards. A dedicated working group has spent several months primarily focused on this matter. They have taken the time to consult with key stakeholders in the local communities and members involved in the original creation of the WCA recognized regions list. After considering the feedback from these stakeholders, the WCA Board has unanimously agreed to adopt the proposed changes put forth by the working group.

Please feel free to direct any questions or concerns to [board@worldcubeassocation.org](mailto:board@worldcubeassociation.org).

*Note (June 24th, 2023): The WCA Board apologizes for the confusion that has arisen so far regarding this announcement. The Board and WSOT are working to consolidate the context and justifications for this decision. We expect this report to be available in the next few days.*

*Note (June 29th, 2023): Thank you all for your patience. Please feel free to head over to the [WCA Forum](https://forum.worldcubeassociation.org/t/further-details-on-changes-to-the-recognition-of-regions/37478), where you will find a thread with much more insight into the decision.*

Kind Regards,
WCA Board of Directors

translation.title: WCA 认可地区名称的重要调整
translation.content:
亲爱的 WCA 社区成员：

为使协会采用的标准与国际体育界保持一致，我们现公布几项重要调整。经认真考虑 WCA 体育组织团队（WSOT）专项工作组的建议，我们对以下地区名称作出变更，即日起生效：

* 中国香港（原为香港）
* 中国澳门（原为澳门）
* 中华台北（原为台湾）

此外，中华台北将使用 WCA 中华台北旗帜。相关变更将在未来一个月内逐步应用于 WCA 各项服务。

我们希望强调，这并非草率作出的决定，其目的仅在于与国际奥委会（IOC）的标准保持一致。专项工作组为此投入了数月时间，征询了当地社区主要相关方，以及曾参与制定 WCA 认可地区名单的成员的意见。考虑这些反馈后，WCA 董事会一致同意采纳工作组提出的调整。

如有任何疑问或顾虑，请联系 [board@worldcubeassocation.org](mailto:board@worldcubeassociation.org)。

*补充说明（2023 年 6 月 24 日）：WCA 董事会对本公告目前造成的困惑表示歉意。董事会与 WSOT 正在整理这项决定的背景和依据，预计将在未来几天内发布报告。*

*补充说明（2023 年 6 月 29 日）：感谢大家的耐心等待。欢迎前往 [WCA 论坛](https://forum.worldcubeassociation.org/t/further-details-on-changes-to-the-recognition-of-regions/37478)，相关主题中有对此项决定更详细的说明。*

此致

WCA 董事会
